meta.topic: uv shorts — pip said ERROR and Successfully in the same breath
meta.onePayoff: pip overwrites a package another project needs, reports success, and nothing crashes until much later.
meta.openLoop: How does one command say ERROR and Successfully installed?
meta.analogy: One shelf, one slot, and the last install wins.

seo.title: pip said ERROR and Successfully in the same breath #python #pip
seo.description: One slot on the shelf, two projects that disagree, and pip narrating the overwrite itself. Complete uv course on the channel.

scenes.narration: It said ERROR. Then it said Successfully installed. Same command.
Your machine has one shelf. Every project you own reaches into it, and one slot holds exactly one version of a package. So when a second project needs a different version, something has to give.

uvStage.headline: One shelf, [every] project
uvStage.premise: One shelf for the whole machine, and one slot holds exactly one parcel.

scenes.narration: Watch pip narrate it. Attempting uninstall. Found existing installation. Uninstalling. Pip just lifted out a package another project depends on, and never asked that project a thing.

uvStage.headline: The last install [wins]
uvStage.premise: The newcomer takes the slot. Whatever sat in it is carried away.

steps.label: pip install "pygments==2.0.0"
steps.detail: nobody asked the project that needed it

scenes.narration: Then these two lines, four apart. ERROR, naming the exact thing it just broke. And then, calmly, Successfully installed.

uvStage.headline: It said [both] of these
uvStage.premise: Two real lines, four lines apart, from one command.

steps.label: pip install "pygments==2.0.0"
out: but you have pygments 2.0 which is incompatible.

scenes.narration: And nothing crashes. Your code runs perfectly happily, which is the cruel part — the shelf is wrong now, and stays wrong until some other day trips over it.

uvStage.headline: Wrong now. Painful [later].
uvStage.premise: The break and the symptom are days apart, which is what makes it expensive.

stage.label: Tuesday
stage.sub: you installed something. it said success.

stage.label: Friday
stage.sub: a different project fails, for no reason

scenes.narration: The fix is a shelf per project. uv builds it for you.
